title: Medium, two outcomes: input validation and a small CLI

requests.text: Two things for this project. First, validate the inputs of every function in math.js: throw a TypeError when an argument is not a finite number. Second, add a small command-line tool, cli.js, used as `node cli.js add 2 3`, that prints the result and exits with a non-zero code on bad input. Add node:test tests for both.
